objective: Diagnosticar el error HTTP al abrir Detalle de Ventas del Dashboard Comercial, reproducido en CIENFUEGOS septiembre 2026. No modificar codigo ni SQL. PROHIBIDO tocar o ejecutar sincronizacion de Inteligencia Comercial, Sync_Sales, Sync_PAX, ISCAM, Scheduler, ventas abiertas/cerradas, Tablero Ejecutivo, Portal de Inteligencia Comercial o Produccion.

queries.name: cienfuegos_unidad_por_server
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 5 codigo,nombre,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),server_id) AS server_id,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),sucursal_origen_id) AS sucursal_origen_id,ISNULL(activo,1) AS activo FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),server_id)='6d053c22-523e-48c0-b72b-96081e2d781b' ORDER BY nombre

queries.name: cienfuegos_detalle_total_exact
queries.sql: WITH tickets AS (SELECT id_transaccion,numero_ticket,MIN(COALESCE(fecha_hora,CAST(fecha_operacion AS DATETIME2))) AS fecha,SUM(ISNULL(importe_neto,0)) AS total_venta,MAX(ISNULL(pax,0)) AS pax,COUNT(*) AS num_productos FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 AND YEAR(fecha_operacion)=2026 AND MONTH(fecha_operacion) IN (9) AND fecha_operacion>='2026-09-01' AND fecha_operacion<='2026-09-28' GROUP BY id_transaccion,numero_ticket) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM tickets

queries.name: cienfuegos_detalle_page_exact
queries.sql: WITH tickets AS (SELECT id_transaccion,numero_ticket,MIN(COALESCE(fecha_hora,CAST(fecha_operacion AS DATETIME2))) AS fecha,SUM(ISNULL(importe_neto,0)) AS total_venta,MAX(ISNULL(pax,0)) AS pax,COUNT(*) AS num_productos FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 AND YEAR(fecha_operacion)=2026 AND MONTH(fecha_operacion) IN (9) AND fecha_operacion>='2026-09-01' AND fecha_operacion<='2026-09-28' GROUP BY id_transaccion,numero_ticket) SELECT numero_ticket,fecha,total_venta,pax,num_productos,CASE WHEN pax>0 THEN total_venta/pax ELSE NULL END AS pax_promedio FROM tickets ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT,numero_ticket) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT,numero_ticket) ASC,numero_ticket ASC,fecha ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 50 ROWS ONLY

queries.name: detalle_schema_nullable
queries.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME='Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto' AND COLUMN_NAME IN ('unidad_negocio_id','fecha_operacion','fecha_hora','numero_ticket','id_transaccion','importe_neto','pax','activo','es_kpi_valido','cancelado_origen') ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
